frame_uncommon.png:
A very THIN decorative border frame for a playing card, ONLY the frame - the entire area inside it must be empty.
Portrait orientation, the frame hugs the outer edge of the canvas all the way around, slightly rounded corners.

THE MOST IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT - THICKNESS: the frame band must be extremely slim, no more than 3% of the canvas
width (about 30 pixels on a 1024 wide canvas). It is a slender trim, not a wide moulding. Do not thicken it at the
corners either - any corner accent must stay inside that same 3% band. If in doubt, make it thinner.

Style: a slender split-bamboo trim in natural straw tones with a small dark blue cord wrap at each corner. Hand-drawn looking with real material texture, not a flat vector line, but rendered within that
slim band. It must still read when the whole card is only 170 pixels wide, so keep the shapes bold and simple.

Everything inside the frame and everything outside it must be solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat,
no shading - this is a chroma key. Do not draw any background, paper or fill inside the frame.
No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no illustration, no character.
Output 1024x1536 PNG. Save the image as frame_uncommon.png in the current directory and report the path.
